description: binding-v1: snapshot v2 S, observed order O and context M give the binding object. The 21 cases of the contract table, plus 11 cases (origin grammar:) that pin the Appendix G origin grammar and 7 that pin types, the checkout ref hash (the id up to its first ?) and the one-order rule (context bound_elsewhere). observed.checkout_ref is the raw id, which stays with the checking service; context.recorded_checkout_ref_hash is its hash. Every case that varies merchant_origin is in handoff mode; the shop_agent cases' merchant_origin: match is provisional (the shop_agent origin rule waits on S1).
